examples.text: Brand guidelines · An orderly desk for personal notes.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Keep the name separate from the symbol. Use white cover text and a 32 px gap between the identity and guide title.
examples.title: Cover composition

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Use Active Tab #2457C5 for this divider, with white type and one short statement. Introduce a working tool, not a commercial landing page.

examples.text: Inicio para orientarte. Notas para escribir.
examples.title: Un espacio para tus notas

examples.text: Align the heading and supporting line to one left edge. Leave the remaining space open rather than adding decorative note cards.
examples.title: Divider rhythm

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.text: Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: English explains the design rules. Spanish specimens define the app’s visible copy. Show the fictional-example notice once on each interface page.
examples.title: Reading this guide

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Keep the guide in five consecutive groups. Use page numbers and short labels rather than a dense thumbnail grid.

examples.text: Opening 01–04 · Definition 05–08 · Logo 09–15.
examples.title: 01–15 · Identity

examples.text: Typography 16–22 · Colors 23–25 · Graphic elements, icons and image direction 26–29.
examples.title: 16–29 · Visual system

examples.text: Design studies 30–48 · Colophon 49. These guide pages do not add routes to the two-page app.
examples.title: 30–49 · Applications

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define the identity through the selected note and its working context. Use the blue tab to connect selection, editing and confirmed state—not as a repeated background pattern.

examples.text: The selected row meets the editor on one continuous white surface. A blue tab marks that shared edge.
examples.title: Tu nota, en contexto

examples.text: Inicio uses an open summary. Notas uses a connected list and editor. Both retain the same header and navigation.
examples.title: Two distinct compositions

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express the project’s intended purpose, not an invented corporate manifesto. Describe personal note work without adding collaboration, account recovery or commercial promises.

examples.text: Una app ficticia para crear, editar, fijar, buscar y eliminar notas personales sin cuentas.
examples.title: Purpose statement

examples.text: Un escritorio directo: un resumen al entrar y una lista conectada con la nota abierta.
examples.title: Experience statement

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Translate the plan into design priorities: clarity, continuity and restraint. Treat these as project criteria rather than claims about an established organization.

examples.text: Use “Cambios sin guardar” for an edited draft and “Guardada” only after server confirmation.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: Keep the selected note, local draft and focus intact while the list refreshes or a search excludes its row.
examples.title: Continuity

examples.text: Show real counts and useful regions. Do not fill an empty desk with sample notes, decorative metrics or promotional panels.
examples.title: Restraint

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write brief, operational Spanish. Name the action, state what happened and offer the next step. Avoid enthusiasm that conceals uncertainty or makes privacy guarantees beyond the plan.

examples.text: Escribe un título para guardar la nota.
examples.title: Validation

examples.text: No sabemos si se guardó. Recupera el envío original antes de enviar otra versión.
examples.title: Uncertain result

examples.text: Nota no disponible. Puedes volver a la lista y elegir otra nota.
examples.title: Unavailable reference

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the identity on white. Pair the open-pocket symbol with the exact name, keeping the blue note tab as the only accent within the mark.

examples.text: Use mixed case exactly as shown. Do not shorten the visible name to initials in the main identity.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Place one large lockup on the page. Explain its pocket-and-tab construction in a short caption, without alternate decorative logos.
examples.title: Section composition

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The rounded pocket suggests containment; the rectangular blue tab suggests an accessible note. Preserve the supplied SVG geometry as the single master for all derived symbols.

examples.text: A compact symbol sits to the left of “Notas de Bolsillo”. The name remains live IBM Plex Sans text.
examples.title: Header identity

examples.text: Header, favicon and application icons use the same pocket outline and tab position, not separately redrawn interpretations.
examples.title: Shared geometry

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Use a horizontal lockup: a 32 px symbol canvas, an 8 px gap and the name in IBM Plex Sans 600. Align the symbol optically with the text and preserve natural letter spacing.

examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo · 20 px/600 name beside the 32 px mark. Keep navigation visually separate from the lockup.
examples.title: Standard header

examples.text: At 390 px, retain the full name. Move navigation into an accessible responsive arrangement rather than compressing the letters.
examples.title: Narrow header

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Reserve clear space equal to one quarter of the symbol canvas on every side of the lockup. This space excludes the internal symbol-to-name gap.

examples.text: Keep at least 8 px clear around the complete identity. Begin Inicio and Notas navigation beyond this protected area.
examples.title: 32 px header symbol

examples.text: Reserve 20 px around the lockup. Do not let a page rule, caption or blue selection tab enter that space.
examples.title: 80 px print symbol

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the mark’s ink, white and blue fills unchanged. On blue or dark applications, place the complete symbol on a white support surface instead of reversing its colors.

examples.text: Use the original mark on Clear Sheet #FFFFFF or Desk Mist #E8EDF4, with the name in Working Ink #17263C.
examples.title: Light desk

examples.text: On #17263C, use a white support tile behind the symbol and white live text for “Notas de Bolsillo”. Keep the safezone visible.
examples.title: Dark cover

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the symbol alone only where the app name is already available in context or through an accessible label. Prefer a 24 px or larger canvas; reserve 16 px for favicon use.

examples.text: Center the unchanged pocket on a white square. Scale uniformly and retain its original viewBox proportions.
examples.title: Application icon

examples.text: A standalone linked mark is named “Notas de Bolsillo”. When the adjacent name already labels the link, hide the redundant symbol from assistive technology.
examples.title: Accessible identity

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Never stretch, rotate, outline or recolor the mark. Do not replace the pocket with initials, insert text into the SVG or turn the note tab into a notification badge.

examples.text: Do not add ruled lines, folded corners, shadows or paper textures to the pocket symbol.
examples.title: Wrong: decorative paper

examples.text: Do not turn the logo red when saving fails. Keep the identity stable and show the error beside the affected action.
examples.title: Wrong: identity as status

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce IBM Plex Sans with a short Spanish specimen. Keep the composition left aligned and let spacing—not additional type families—separate heading, explanation and action.

examples.text: Encuentra una nota, abre su contenido y sigue escribiendo.
examples.title: Un escritorio claro

examples.text: Use a 36 px heading and 16 px supporting line. Keep at least 24 px between the specimen and any technical caption.
examples.title: Type divider

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans for headings, fields, controls and metadata. Its shared letterforms keep the summary and editor connected without making every element equally prominent.

examples.text: Consulta las fijadas o abre una nota reciente.
examples.title: Tus notas

examples.text: Use 600 for headings, 400 for reading and 500 for compact controls. Do not add a handwriting font to reinforce the pocket metaphor.
examples.title: One-family system

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans is the selected family; supplied files include 400, 500, 600 and 700. The app uses local 400/500/600. A system sans is an emergency fallback, not the intended identity.

examples.text: El título es obligatorio. El texto es opcional.
examples.title: Escribe a tu ritmo

examples.text: Keep Spanish accents and punctuation intact: “Título”, “Todavía”, “¿Eliminar esta nota?”. Use natural tracking for fields and body text.
examples.title: Character treatment

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use upright 400 for body and fields, 500 for navigation and buttons, and 600 for app headings and the name. Reserve the supplied 700 guide-heading setting for manual covers and dividers.

examples.text: Los cambios se mostrarán como guardados cuando llegue la confirmación.
examples.title: Guardar nota

examples.text: Set “Título” at 500 and its entered value at 400. Avoid italic status messages, synthetic bold and all-caps navigation.
examples.title: Weight, not decoration

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use the same family for secondary information at 12–14 px. Set metadata in Working Ink with checked contrast; Steady Edge is not the default small-text color.

examples.text: Guarda la nota para confirmar esta versión.
examples.title: Cambios sin guardar

examples.text: Place the real server-confirmed date beside “Guardada” at 14 px/400. Keep it subordinate through size and spacing, not faint text.
examples.title: Metadata composition

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use app headings at 28–36 px/600, body and fields at 16 px/400, controls at 14–16 px/500 and metadata at 12–14 px. Let long editor titles wrap without altering their data.

examples.text: Crea tu primera nota para empezar.
examples.title: Todavía no tienes notas

examples.text: Use a 28 px heading, 16 px explanation and “Crear mi primera nota” action. Keep confirmed zero counts separate from the heading.
examples.title: Empty-state stack

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use 4/8/12/16/24/32 px spacing. At 1440 px, give the list about 320 px; at 768 px, 240 px. At 390 px, alternate list and editor within /notas, with 16 px side margins.

examples.text: Conserva el contexto de la nota mientras recorres tu escritorio.
examples.title: Volver a la lista

examples.text: Join list and flexible editor on one white surface. On Inicio, pair a narrow pinned region with a wider unpinned recent region.
examples.title: Desktop composition

examples.text: Allow about 56 px for header, 44 px for return, 52 px for state/action and 96 px for the title group. Keep controls in normal flow.
examples.title: Mobile editor

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use color to separate the desk, working surface and current action. Keep white dominant inside the editor and reserve blue for meaningful selection and primary controls.

examples.text: Desk Mist #E8EDF4 surrounds the continuous Clear Sheet #FFFFFF workspace.
examples.title: Desk and surface

examples.text: Active Tab #2457C5 identifies “Guardar nota” and the selected-note tab. Do not color every row blue.
examples.title: Action and subject

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five palette hex values exactly. Add #A93424 only for semantic alerts. Color never replaces the words and symbols needed to understand a state.

examples.text: Desk Mist: background #E8EDF4. Clear Sheet: surface #FFFFFF. Active Tab: accent #2457C5.
examples.title: Surface roles

examples.text: Working Ink: text #17263C. Steady Edge: functional border #7C899B. Use ink for readable metadata.
examples.title: Structure roles

examples.text: Use #A93424 with an error symbol and “Escribe un título”. Keep destructive meaning separate from the ordinary blue action system.
examples.title: Semantic alert

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep base tokens unchanged. Prefer the supplied desk gray to improvised blue washes. Any derived interaction shade must remain distinguishable and preserve readable text and visible boundaries.

examples.text: Use a blue tab, ink title and explicit selected state. A pale background alone is not enough to identify the open note.
examples.title: Selected row

examples.text: Do not fade the whole control until its label disappears. Retain readable wording and show why the current operation blocks another send.
examples.title: Disabled action

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: The signature element is a blue rectangular tab crossing the list–editor seam. Keep surfaces flat, functional corners at 4 px and separators tied to actual regions.

examples.text: Attach one tab to the open note’s context. Do not scatter tabs across headings or unrelated cards.
examples.title: Selection seam

examples.text: After Fijar or Desfijar is confirmed, move the same row for about 180 ms. With reduced motion, reorder immediately and preserve focus.
examples.title: Confirmed pin movement

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Adapt shadcn/ui controls with a consistent, restrained icon set. Use approximately 20 px icons inside targets of at least 44 px, paired with labels for consequential actions.

examples.text: Pair a pin with “Fijar” or “Desfijar”, and a trash symbol with “Eliminar”. Do not use the brandmark as a generic action icon.
examples.title: Note actions

examples.text: Use a check plus “Guardada”, a neutral pending symbol plus “Guardando…” and an alert plus explanatory error text.
examples.title: Save states

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photography in this identity. Let the selected note and its working surface be the subject. Avoid desk stock images, paper scans and ornamental device mockups.

examples.text: Show a flat, labelled interface study of Inicio or Notas instead of a photographed notebook.
examples.title: Guide illustration

examples.text: Use clearly identified specimen content outside the app. Never show real private notes or crop editor content to imply it has been shortened.
examples.title: Content protection

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build a compact board from the selected index-card desk direction: blue tab, gray field, white surface and clear type. Exclude artificial pagination, mail metaphors and paper simulation.

examples.text: One continuous surface, a visible shared edge, an open summary and a compact pocket symbol.
examples.title: Keep

examples.text: Repeated card grids, envelopes, spiral binding, torn paper, sticky-note shadows and fictional productivity charts.
examples.title: Exclude

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: All following applications are design studies. Keep the identity stable while adapting scale and composition; no study adds commerce, membership or extra app pages.

examples.text: Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use the exact name, original pocket geometry and blue-gray system. Give each format one clear reading path rather than repeating the editor everywhere.
examples.title: Shared application rule

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: center the unchanged mark on white for square and circular avatar crops. Keep the complete pocket inside the crop and omit tiny wordmark text.

examples.text: Una app ficticia de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Scale the full 160-unit symbol canvas to 75% of the avatar width. Use a white background so the ink outline remains visible.
examples.title: Avatar crop

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: use the full business name as the profile name and a factual one-line description. Do not invent handles, follower counts, verification badges or published accounts.

examples.text: App ficticia de Esteban para probar Constructor. Un escritorio personal de notas sin cuentas.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Place the white-supported symbol at left on a gray banner. Keep the biography separate from the image and avoid a promotional call-to-action button.
examples.title: Profile header

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Design study: use a gray field with one white interface region and a short Spanish headline. Label illustrated screens as studies; never imply that sample notes populate a visitor’s session.

examples.text: Estudio de diseño: la pestaña azul conecta la selección con el editor.
examples.title: Una lista. Una nota abierta.

examples.text: Keep the headline above the interface fragment and the name below it. Show the list–editor seam, not a collage of repeated cards.
examples.title: Post layout

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: build a typographic poster around the name and one operational phrase. Use generous gray space, an ink headline and a small blue accent; omit invented URLs and launch claims.

examples.text: Notas de Bolsillo · Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Un escritorio para tus notas

examples.text: Make the phrase dominant, the name secondary and the project notice smallest but readable. Keep the pocket mark in a separate clear zone.
examples.title: Poster hierarchy

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use a small horizontal identity on white or light gray fabric. Preserve the mark’s colors and avoid all-over note patterns, sales language or merchandise claims.

examples.text: Un escritorio claro para tus notas.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use one chest or upper-center tote placement. On dark fabric, include the white support surface rather than reversing the pocket.
examples.title: Placement

pages.title: Pocket reference sleeve
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the takeaway format into a sleeve for printed project references. Use a flat white face, a blue top-edge tab and the identity; do not suggest a shipped product.

examples.text: Inicio: resumen. Notas: lista y editor.
examples.title: Tu escritorio, en dos páginas

examples.text: Keep the name on the front and a short route guide on the reverse. Use the tab once at the opening, not as a repeated packaging pattern.
examples.title: Sleeve structure

pages.title: Workspace entry
pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup directions with a clear entry to the personal workspace. Inicio leads directly to real session data; never insert a promotional gate or login screen.

examples.text: Crear mi primera nota
examples.title: Todavía no tienes notas

examples.text: Show total 0 and fijadas 0 only after a confirmed empty response. During startup, use “Preparando tu sesión…” instead of false zero counts.
examples.title: Entry states

examples.text: Use “No se puede mantener la sesión” with an explicit recovery action. Offer direct app access when embedded cookies are blocked.
examples.title: Session interruption

pages.title: Note controls
pages.summary: Design study: place context, save state and blue Guardar nota on the editor’s top edge. Put pinning and deletion in a separate secondary row. No carts, checkout or account controls.

examples.text: Título obligatorio. Texto opcional.
examples.title: Guardar nota

examples.text: Use a visible focus ring, distinct hover and pressed states, and readable disabled labels. Keep Guardar nota activable for validation; block duplicate pending sends.
examples.title: Control distinction

examples.text: Place “Buscar notas” and “Nueva nota” above the list. Pair “Sin resultados” with “Limpiar búsqueda” without replacing an open editor.
examples.title: List actions

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: replace a receipt with an inline confirmation on the editor edge. Only an authoritative Turso response permits Guardada and its confirmed date; never add a receipt page.

examples.text: Los cambios de esta nota se han confirmado.
examples.title: Guardada

examples.text: Use “Guardando…” while waiting. If the response is lost, show “Resultado sin confirmar” and “Recuperar envío”; do not use a success check.
examples.title: Pending versus uncertain

examples.text: Replace “Guardada” with “Cambios sin guardar” immediately. Keep any original uncertain-send recovery separate from the newly edited draft.
examples.title: After another edit

pages.title: Workflow reference card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a rewards card with a compact action reference. List existing note actions without points, tiers, invented keyboard shortcuts or a membership identity.

examples.text: Busca una nota cuando la necesites. Confirma antes de eliminar.
examples.title: Crear. Editar. Fijar.

examples.text: Use the pocket on the front and five labelled actions on the reverse: Crear, Editar, Fijar, Buscar, Eliminar. Avoid stamp boxes or progress meters.
examples.title: Reference layout

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Design study: adapt venue signage into a presentation sign for the fictional app. Use the full name and a brief descriptor, with no invented address, opening hours or physical location.

examples.text: Escritorio personal de notas · Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Set the name in large ink type on white. Place the symbol to its left and a single blue rule below the descriptor.
examples.title: Sign composition

pages.title: Application website
pages.summary: Design study: retain exactly two interface routes, / and /notas. Inicio is a real private summary; Notas is the working editor. Persistent notes belong in Turso, not a browser-only simulation.

examples.text: Tus notas fijadas y recientes, sin repetir la misma nota en ambos grupos.
examples.title: Inicio

examples.text: Nueva nota → /notas?nueva=1. Ver todas → /notas. A note title → /notas?nota=ID. On mobile, list and editor remain within /notas.
examples.title: Navigation destinations

examples.text: GET /api/info is not a page. Its only fields are nombre: “Notas de Bolsillo” and descripcion: “App ficticia de Esteban para probar Constructor.”
examples.title: Public information

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive favicon and application icons from the same SVG master. Keep the white support surface and the blue tab visible; never substitute a template icon or an initial.

examples.text: Resumen de tus notas personales.
examples.title: Inicio | Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use the original geometry for app/icon.svg, favicon and derived Apple icon artwork. Scale the complete mark uniformly within each square canvas.
examples.title: Icon family

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: use a small top-left lockup, wide white margins and an ink text column. Reserve blue for section rules and labels, not full-page decoration.

examples.text: Documento de proyecto · Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Align body text with the wordmark’s left edge. Keep a 32 px separation below the header and place the page number quietly in the footer.
examples.title: Document grid

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: treat the card as a project introduction, not an invented corporate contact. Use only the supplied name and Esteban’s stated connection; omit fabricated roles and contact details.

examples.text: Un ejemplo de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Front: centered pocket on white. Reverse: left-aligned name and project description on gray. Do not add a guessed email, domain or QR destination.
examples.title: Two-sided card

pages.title: Invitation card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a gift card with a non-monetary project invitation. Keep the message editorial; do not imply credit, redemption, shared notes or a referral program.

examples.text: Un ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor.
examples.title: Conoce Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use one ink headline, one explanatory line and the pocket below. Exclude amounts, redemption codes, expiry dates and unplanned share actions.
examples.title: Invitation hierarchy

pages.title: Document seal
pages.summary: Design study: adapt a packaging seal into a small project-document label. The mark identifies the project, not certification, encryption approval or a saved-note status.

examples.text: Material de proyecto · Estudio de diseño.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use the unchanged pocket on a white square with 4 px corners. Keep any descriptor outside the SVG and never add a verification tick.
examples.title: Seal treatment

pages.title: User support
pages.summary: Design study: keep help beside the affected task, not on an added support page. State the problem and recovery action without exposing private data or inventing a support channel.

examples.text: Vas a eliminar «Lista de ideas». Cancelar · Eliminar nota
examples.title: ¿Eliminar esta nota?

examples.text: Use the actual selected title; this title is specimen copy only. Focus Cancelar first, contain keyboard focus and restore it after closing.
examples.title: Deletion dialogue

examples.text: Label “Tu borrador”, “Última versión confirmada” and “Versión actual”. Keep the form visible; offer “Usar versión actual” or explicit overwrite.
examples.title: Conflict help

pages.title: Thank you

examples.text: Un escritorio claro. Una nota en contexto.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Identity and behavior: supplied Esteban project plan. Typeface availability: supplied IBM Plex Sans files, weights 400–700. No external public brand sources were supplied.

examples.text: Original pocket geometry and this visual system are proposed for Notas de Bolsillo. Preserve the exact name, palette and shared mark geometry in subsequent applications.

brandbook.voice: Español claro, breve y operativo. Nombrar las acciones y distinguir guardado, cambios pendientes, conflicto e incertidumbre sin tecnicismos innecesarios. Aviso discreto por página: «Ejemplo ficticio de Esteban para probar Constructor».
